The highlighted row is a * secondary wash and the chosen row says so with a quiet tick — accent never * marks "selected". */ const Select = SelectPrimitive.Root const SelectGroup = SelectPrimitive.Group const SelectValue = SelectPrimitive.Value const SelectTrigger = React.forwardRef< HTMLButtonElement, WithClassName >(({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => ( {children} )) SelectTrigger.displayName = "SelectTrigger" const SelectScrollUpButton = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName >(({ className, ...props }, ref) => ( )) SelectScrollUpButton.displayName = "SelectScrollUpButton" const SelectScrollDownButton = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName >(({ className, ...props }, ref) => ( )) SelectScrollDownButton.displayName = "SelectScrollDownButton" const SelectContent = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName & Pick >(({ className, children, align, alignOffset, side, sideOffset = 6, ...props }, ref) => ( {children} )) SelectContent.displayName = "SelectContent" const SelectLabel = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName >(({ className, ...props }, ref) => ( )) SelectLabel.displayName = "SelectLabel" const SelectItem = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName >(({ className, children, ...props }, ref) => ( {children} )) SelectItem.displayName = "SelectItem" const SelectSeparator = React.forwardRef< HTMLDivElement, WithClassName >(({ className, ...props }, ref) => ( )) SelectSeparator.displayName = "SelectSeparator" export { Select, SelectGroup, SelectValue, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectLabel, SelectItem, SelectSeparator, SelectScrollUpButton, SelectScrollDownButton, }
